last_etwap_base_supply_at_init.meaning: lastETWAPBaseSupply value seeded during market init

first_mint_crosses_no_cap_limit.meaning: a first mint occurred that crossed the noCapLimit threshold, adding just over one token

subsequent_mint_reverted.meaning: a subsequent mint after the threshold reverted with E_LEX_MintCapExceeded
subsequent_mint_reverted.checkpoint: subsequent mint attempt after threshold crossing

assumptions: The first over-threshold mint is treated as an ordinary user action; no special authorization is required for minting.
The subsequent mint is a valid follow-up deposit that should succeed absent the stale-TWAP cap condition.

unresolved.description: Report does not give a numeric definition of the noCapLimit threshold or the exact 'just over one token' amount; the crossing is represented as a grounded Boolean.

limitations: The 'roughly an hour' freeze duration and 30-minute half-life recovery are not encoded; only the direct revert of the subsequent mint is formalized.
The stale-TWAP comparison mechanism is a root cause and is not encoded as a precondition or as the impact.
